HR GK.q: Haryana shares its boundary with how many states?
HR GK.e: Haryana borders Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand; it also surrounds the NCT of Delhi.

HR GK.q: Which state lies to the south-west of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Haryana’s south and south-west boundary meets Rajasthan.

HR GK.q: Shivalik hills are present in which part of Haryana?
HR GK.e: The Shivalik belt spans Ambala, Panchkula and parts of Yamunanagar in the northeast.

HR GK.q: The Shivalik hills are NOT found in which district?
HR GK.e: Sirsa lies in the west–southwest plains, outside the Shivalik zone.

HR GK.q: The highest point of the Morni hills is known as:
HR GK.e: Karoh Peak near Morni (Panchkula) is Haryana’s highest point.

HR GK.q: What is the average elevation of the Yamuna–Ghaggar plain in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Many references treat the piedmont to plain belt as averaging around 300–375 m.

HR GK.q: What are the flood plains of the Ghaggar river called in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Local terms: Yamuna floodplain = Khadar; Ghaggar floodplain = Nali; Markanda floodplain = Bet.

HR GK.q: Keekar and Khair trees are prevalent in which region of Haryana?
HR GK.e: The southwest sandy tract supports xerophytic species like Keekar (Prosopis) and Khair (Acacia).

HR GK.q: The Aravalli hills do NOT run through:
HR GK.e: The Aravallis pass through Rajasthan, Haryana and Gujarat (and Delhi), not Punjab.

HR GK.q: Where are the floating sandy plains found in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Aeolian sandy plains/dunes occur across these southwest districts.

HR GK.q: The climate of Haryana is:
HR GK.e: Hot summers, cool winters, and monsoonal rainfall define a sub-tropical continental climate.

HR GK.q: Which district receives the highest rainfall in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Rainfall maximises in the Shivalik foothill districts, notably Ambala.

HR GK.q: Consider the following statements: I. Haryana lies between longitudes 74°27′ to 77°36′. II. Shivalik and Aravalli hills lie in the southern part of the state. Which statement(s) is/are correct?
HR GK.e: Shivaliks are in the northeast; Aravallis are in the southwest, so both are not in the south.

HR GK.q: Which district of Haryana has the lowest population?
HR GK.e: As per Census 2011, Panchkula has the smallest population among Haryana districts.

HR GK.q: The Yamuna enters Haryana from which district?
HR GK.e: It enters near Tajewala (now Hathni Kund area) in Yamunanagar.

HR GK.q: The Tajewala barrage is located on which river?
HR GK.e: The historical Tajewala Barrage diverted Yamuna waters to canals; replaced by Hathni Kund.

HR GK.q: The Western Yamuna Canal originates from which place on the Yamuna?
HR GK.e: WYC takes off from Tajewala/Hathni Kund Barrage.

HR GK.q: Which of the following rivers is believed to be part of the Sapta-Sindhu region?
HR GK.e: The Vedic Sapta-Sindhu includes the Saraswati, associated with palaeochannels in Haryana.

HR GK.q: The Ghaggar river does NOT pass through which district of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Ghaggar flows through Kaithal, Fatehabad and Sirsa, not Bhiwani.

HR GK.q: The Markanda river enters Haryana from which district?
HR GK.e: The seasonal Markanda descends from the Shivaliks into Ambala.

HR GK.q: Tangri is a tributary of:
HR GK.e: Tangri joins the Markanda system in the Shivalik foothills.

HR GK.q: The Sahibi river originates in which district?
HR GK.e: It rises in the Aravallis near Nuh and flows toward Delhi.

HR GK.q: Which river is also known as Kasaunti?
HR GK.e: Krishnawati is locally called Kasaunti in parts of the Aravalli tract.

HR GK.q: Badkhal Lake is located in which district?
HR GK.e: The lake lies amid the Aravallis in Faridabad.

HR GK.q: Which of the following is the largest wetland of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Bhindawas (Jhajjar) is the state’s largest wetland and a Ramsar site.

HR GK.q: Brahma Sarovar is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The sacred tank is a major pilgrimage site in Kurukshetra.

HR GK.q: Damdama Lake is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The rain-fed lake lies near Sohna in the Aravallis.

HR GK.q: Which lake of Haryana is considered the meeting place of seven Saraswati rivers?
HR GK.e: Tradition holds it as the confluence point of seven Saraswati channels.

HR GK.q: In which year was Sukhna Lake declared a National Wetland?
HR GK.e: The Chandigarh lake (bordering Haryana) received National Wetland status in 1988.

HR GK.q: Which kind of soil is also known as “Raosli” in Haryana?
HR GK.e: “Raosli” denotes light sandy soils typical of the southwest.

HR GK.q: Sierozem (very light soil) is found in which districts?
HR GK.e: These light desertic soils occur in the drier western and southwestern districts.

HR GK.q: The soil of Sonipat district is:
HR GK.e: Western parts are sandier, while central/eastern tracts are loamier.

HR GK.q: The soil of Mahendragarh and Rewari districts is predominantly:
HR GK.e: The semi-arid Aravalli belt features dominantly sandy soils prone to wind erosion.

HR GK.q: Saline soil occurs in parts of:
HR GK.e: Pockets of saline/alkaline soils (“reh”) occur across these districts.

HR GK.q: Soils of Gurugram and Hisar are affected mainly by:
HR GK.e: The sandy, dry conditions make aeolian erosion a major issue.

HR GK.q: Gurugram and Mahendragarh are rich in:
HR GK.e: The Aravalli zone hosts useful building stones including slate.

HR GK.q: Manganese is found in which district of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Limited manganese occurrences are reported from the Aravalli belt here.

HR GK.q: Which district is rich in copper?
HR GK.e: Copper occurrences are associated with Aravalli geology in this district.

HR GK.q: Tropical dry deciduous forest can be seen in which district(s) of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Patches occur in Aravalli and bir/protected groves across these districts.

HR GK.q: The Kandi Development Project was launched by the Haryana Government in:
HR GK.e: The project targets the Shivalik foothill (Kandi) belt for irrigation and livelihood improvements.

HR GK.q: In Haryana, ‘Tree Day’ is observed on:
HR GK.e: The state marks Tree Day annually to promote mass plantation.

HR GK.q: Sultanpur National Park is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: A Ramsar site famed for migratory birds, located near Gurugram city.

HR GK.q: In which year was Kalesar declared a National Park?
HR GK.e: Kalesar (Yamunanagar) became a National Park in 2003.

HR GK.q: Nahar Wildlife Sanctuary is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The sanctuary near Kosli conserves woodland fauna including nilgai and leopards.

HR GK.q: Saraswati Conservation Reserve is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: It protects ecological stretches associated with the ancient Saraswati system.

HR GK.q: The Crocodile Breeding Centre is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: Near Thanesar, it is among North India’s important reptile conservation centres.

HR GK.q: Which among the following districts is/are included in Western Agro Climate Zone of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Haryana's Western Agro-Climatic Zone includes Sirsa, Hisar, Bhiwani, Fatehabad, and parts of Mahendragarh. These regions are characterized by arid to semi-arid conditions with lower rainfall and sandy soils.

HR GK.q: Which crop is produced most in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Haryana is a major wheat producer (part of India’s “wheat bowl”), with wheat leading total output.

HR GK.q: Which Kharif crop covers the maximum agricultural area in Haryana?
HR GK.e: In Kharif season, paddy (rice) occupies the largest area due to canal/tubewell irrigation in eastern districts.

HR GK.q: Which district is known as Rice Bowl of the state?
HR GK.e: Karnal is noted for intensive paddy cultivation and milling/processing, earning the “Rice Bowl” tag.

HR GK.q: The main objective of National Food Security Mission is to increase the production of:
HR GK.e: NFSM initially focused on boosting wheat and pulses through productivity-enhancing interventions.

HR GK.q: Indo-Dutch project was launched in Haryana in collaboration with which country?
HR GK.e: “Indo-Dutch” denotes cooperation with the Netherlands, known for agri/horticulture and dairy expertise.

HR GK.q: In which year was the Haryana State Seed Certification Agency established?
HR GK.e: The agency was set up to certify quality seeds and support seed replacement in the state.

HR GK.q: Which district in Haryana is the largest producer of fruits and vegetables?
HR GK.e: Sirsa’s extensive horticulture—vegetables and citrus—gives it a leading share in F&V output.

HR GK.q: Which fruit is grown on the largest area in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Mango orchards occupy the maximum fruit acreage across several districts in Haryana.

HR GK.q: Which among the following is a popular sheep breed found in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Hisardale is a crossbred sheep developed around Hisar; Sahiwal/Jamunapari are cattle/goat breeds.

HR GK.q: Where was the first cotton mill started in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Bhiwani housed the state’s earliest cotton-textile unit, aligned with the cotton belt.

HR GK.q: First paper mill was started in the state in which year?
HR GK.e: The state’s first paper manufacturing unit dates to 1929.

HR GK.q: Which city is considered the biggest industrial city of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Faridabad is a major industrial hub (engineering, auto parts, appliances) with the largest base.

HR GK.q: Panchkula is famous for which type of industries?
HR GK.e: Panchkula’s profile includes electronics, IT-adjacent units and light engineering.

HR GK.q: Haryana has its printing and packaging clusters at which district?
HR GK.e: The Yamunanagar–Jagadhri belt is noted for paper and packaging with allied printing clusters.

HR GK.q: Jagadhri, where Shatabdi trains’ maintenance is undertaken, is in which district?
HR GK.e: Jagadhri (Yamunanagar) hosts railway workshop facilities handling periodic maintenance.

HR GK.q: Which was the first industry set up in Gurugram?
HR GK.e: Gurgaon’s modern industrialization began with automobile manufacturing before IT/ITES grew.

HR GK.q: Due to scientific equipment production, which city is nicknamed ‘Science City’?
HR GK.e: Ambala Cantonment is renowned for scientific and precision instruments.

HR GK.q: The city of Sonipat is popular for which industry?
HR GK.e: Sonipat has a large cluster of bicycle and bicycle-parts manufacturers.

HR GK.q: Which place has a flourishing “Tilla Jutti” footwear craft?
HR GK.e: Rewari is famous for traditional leather crafts including ornate Tilla Jutti.

HR GK.q: In which year did HSIDC come into existence?
HR GK.e: HSIDC (now HSIIDC) was established in 1967 to develop industrial infrastructure.

HR GK.q: Which organisation is responsible for industrial infrastructure development in the state?
HR GK.e: As per this key, PWD is marked; HSIIDC also develops estates/parks but the answer here is PWD.

HR GK.q: At which district is an Industrial Model Township proposed?
HR GK.e: The proposal mentioned places an IMT at Faridabad in this set.

HR GK.q: In which district has Reliance set up its SEZ?
HR GK.e: Reliance MET/SEZ footprint is linked with the Jhajjar belt near Gurugram–Jhajjar.

HR GK.q: Which place in Haryana is being developed as a storage and warehouse hub?
HR GK.e: Rewari (rail freight), Faridabad and Panipat (NH corridors) are promoted as logistics/warehousing nodes.

HR GK.q: Which of the following is the biggest power station of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Panipat Thermal Power Station has the largest installed capacity among state plants.

HR GK.q: In which year was the Panipat Thermal Power Station commissioned?
HR GK.e: Commercial generation at PTPS commenced in the late 1970s; 1979 is cited in this key.

HR GK.q: Rajiv Gandhi Thermal Power Project is located in which district?
HR GK.e: RGTPP (Khedar) is situated in Hisar district.

HR GK.q: Mahatma Gandhi Thermal Power Project is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The MGTPP (CLP Jhajjar) is located in Jhajjar.

HR GK.q: In which district is the Kakroi Hydel Project located?
HR GK.e: Kakroi small hydel station lies on the Western Yamuna Canal near Sonipat.

HR GK.q: In which district is a Nuclear Power Plant of 2800 MW capacity set up?
HR GK.e: The Gorakhpur Haryana Anu Vidyut Pariyojana (GHAVP) site is in Fatehabad.

HR GK.q: Which non-conventional source of energy is found abundantly in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Haryana’s plains have strong solar insolation; wind/tidal potential is limited inland.

HR GK.q: The first solar power plant in Haryana was set up in which village?
HR GK.e: Nandpa is cited in this key as the first grid-connected solar unit location.

HR GK.q: Which programme is launched by Government of Haryana for developing skilled manpower in renewable energy?
HR GK.e: Surya Mitra trains technicians for solar PV installation and O&M.

HR GK.q: Where in Haryana was the first bio-gas plant set up?
HR GK.e: Panipat is recorded here as the location for the state’s first biogas initiative.

HR GK.q: Haryana Government formulated its Renewable Energy Policy in the year:
HR GK.e: The initial comprehensive state renewable energy policy framework dates to 2005.

HR GK.q: Haryana Electricity Reform Act was passed in the year:
HR GK.e: State power-sector restructuring legislation was enacted in 1997 as per this key.

HR GK.q: Hathnikund Barrage is located over which river?
HR GK.e: Hathnikund (which replaced the old Tajewala headworks) is on the Yamuna in Yamunanagar.

HR GK.q: The district of Ambala is dependent for irrigation on:
HR GK.e: Ambala’s irrigation relies mainly on canal systems in the Shivalik foothill belt.

HR GK.q: Jui Canal Project was primarily designed to irrigate the semi-desert areas of:
HR GK.e: The Jui project targets arid/semi-arid tracts of Bhiwani region.

HR GK.q: Tajewala Barrage built across Yamuna river is located in:
HR GK.e: The old Tajewala headworks site falls within present Yamunanagar district.

HR GK.q: Which agency is responsible for generation of power in Haryana?
HR GK.e: HPGCL operates the state’s generation assets; HVPNL handles transmission; HERC is the regulator.

HR GK.q: Which district in Haryana has the largest network of roads?
HR GK.e: Owing to its large area and connectivity, Bhiwani records the greatest total road length.

HR GK.q: Which district in Haryana has the highest road density?
HR GK.e: Compact, urbanized Ambala shows the highest roads per square kilometre in this key.

HR GK.q: The Grand Trunk Road does not pass through which district?
HR GK.e: GT Road/NH-44 spans Sonipat–Panipat–Karnal–Kurukshetra–Ambala; it bypasses Bhiwani.

HR GK.q: Dharuhera industrial area is located on which National Highway?
HR GK.e: Dharuhera lies on the Delhi–Jaipur corridor (old NH-8, now NH-48).

HR GK.q: Delhi–Faridabad Skyway is a part of which National Highway?
HR GK.e: The elevated skyway aligns with the Delhi–Agra axis (old NH-2; renumbered segments now NH-19/44).

HR GK.q: Panipat Expressway is a part of which National Highway?
HR GK.e: The Delhi–Panipat express corridor corresponds to the historic NH-1 (GT Road) segment.

HR GK.q: In KMP Expressway, ‘K’ stands for:
HR GK.e: KMP = Kundli–Manesar–Palwal Expressway; ‘K’ denotes Kundli (Sonipat).

HR GK.q: Haryana Roadways Engineering Corporation is situated at:
HR GK.e: HREC, the engineering/maintenance arm for transport vehicles, is located in Gurugram.

HR GK.q: Where did the first train run in Haryana?
HR GK.e: The Delhi–Rewari line, part of Rajputana–Malwa Railway, is among the earliest in the region.

HR GK.q: Which city in Haryana had the first metro rail?
HR GK.e: Rapid Metro (2013) made Gurugram the first Haryana city with an operational metro.

HR GK.q: In which year was the Civil Aviation wing of Haryana Government formed?
HR GK.e: With Haryana’s formation as a separate state in 1966, its Civil Aviation wing was constituted.

HR GK.q: Ambala Air Force Station was built in:
HR GK.e: Ambala AFS was established soon after independence as a key forward base.

HR GK.q: Which among the following is a magazine by Sahitya Akademi, Haryana?
HR GK.e: Harigandha is the official literary magazine of Haryana Sahitya Akademi.

HR GK.q: Which Haryanvi film released in 2014 received two National Awards?
HR GK.e: “Pagdi: The Honour” (2014) won two National Awards, including Best Film on Social Issues.

HR GK.q: Jyotisar is famous for what?
HR GK.e: Jyotisar (Kurukshetra) is revered as the place where Lord Krishna delivered the Bhagavad Gita.

HR GK.q: Al-Biruni’s ‘Kitab-ul-Hind’ mentions which lake in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Al-Biruni described the sacred Brahmasarovar of Kurukshetra in his work.

HR GK.q: Sthaneswar Mahadev Temple is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The historic Sthaneswar Mahadev temple complex lies in Kurukshetra.

HR GK.q: The famous Mansa Devi Temple is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: Mata Mansa Devi Temple is a major Shakti peeth near Panchkula.

HR GK.q: Which ruler built the Kabuli Bagh Mosque located in Panipat?
HR GK.e: Babur erected the Kabuli Bagh Mosque after his victory in the First Battle of Panipat (1526).

HR GK.q: Which famous monument was built in 1857 in Ambala cantonment area?
HR GK.e: St. Paul’s Church was built in 1857 at Ambala Cantonment.

HR GK.q: Which ruler constructed the Fort of Gohana?
HR GK.e: Gohana Fort is traditionally attributed to Prithviraj Chauhan.

HR GK.q: Which historical place in Haryana was built by Shah Kuli Khan?
HR GK.e: Jal Mahal at Narnaul was constructed by Shah Quli Khan, a Mughal noble.

HR GK.q: Which town in Haryana is called the “town of stepwells and ponds”?
HR GK.e: Narnaul is famous for numerous historical baolis (stepwells) and ponds.

HR GK.q: The mound of Rakhigarhi was excavated by:
HR GK.e: ASI’s Amarendra Nath led major excavations at the Harappan site of Rakhigarhi (Hisar).

HR GK.q: The second largest site excavated in Haryana after Rakhigarhi is:
HR GK.e: Farmana (Rohtak) is considered Haryana’s second largest Harappan site after Rakhigarhi.

HR GK.q: Which district in Haryana has the Manjhi Sahib Gurudwara?
HR GK.e: Manji Sahib (Ambala) is a significant Sikh shrine linked to the Gurus’ visits.

HR GK.q: Which district of Haryana is also known as ‘Chhoti Kashi’?
HR GK.e: Bhiwani is called ‘Chhoti Kashi’ owing to its many temples.

HR GK.q: The famous Star Monument in Haryana is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The Star Monument (samadhi of Saint Tarachand Ji) is located in Bhiwani.

HR GK.q: Hisar-e-Firoza was constructed by which Muslim ruler?
HR GK.e: Hisar (originally Hisar-e-Firoza) was founded by Firoz Shah Tughlaq in 1354.

HR GK.q: Bhuteshwara Temple is situated in which district?
HR GK.e: The Bhuteshwara Mahadev temple complex lies in Jind.

HR GK.q: Sheikh Chilli’s tomb is situated where in Haryana?
HR GK.e: The Mughal-era tomb of Sufi saint Sheikh Chilli is in Thanesar (Kurukshetra).

HR GK.q: The world’s second temple of Lord Parashuram in Haryana is in which district?
HR GK.e: A rare temple dedicated to Lord Parashuram is located in Palwal.

HR GK.q: Which district of Haryana is famous for metal works?
HR GK.e: Rewari is known for traditional brass/metal ware craftsmanship.

HR GK.q: Which district was earlier called Abdullahpur?
HR GK.e: The Yamunanagar area was historically referred to as Abdullahpur.

HR GK.q: In which year was the Haryana Tourism Corporation established?
HR GK.e: HTC was set up in 1966 to promote tourism after the creation of the state.

HR GK.q: Which organisation proposed the separation of Haryana for the first time in 1926?
HR GK.e: The League mooted a proposal for Haryana’s separation from Punjab in 1926.

HR GK.q: Pandit Neki Ram Sharma concentrated his nationalist activities in which region of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Neki Ram Sharma worked extensively in the Rohtak region during the freedom movement.

HR GK.q: In 1947, after India’s Independence, Haryana was part of which Indian state?
HR GK.e: Haryana was carved out of Punjab in 1966; prior to that it formed part of Punjab.

HR GK.q: During which year was the Sachar Formula introduced?
HR GK.e: The 1949 Sachar Formula addressed distribution of services/jobs between Punjab and PEPSU regions.

HR GK.q: According to the Sachar Formula, which districts came under ‘Hindi Area’?
HR GK.e: Hindi-speaking districts such as Rohtak, Hisar and Gurugram were grouped together.

HR GK.q: In which year was the Fazal Ali Aayog formed?
HR GK.e: The States Reorganisation Commission (SRC) chaired by Fazal Ali was constituted in 1953.

HR GK.q: In which year did the Fazal Ali Commission submit its report?
HR GK.e: The SRC submitted its report in 1955 recommending reorganisation of states.

HR GK.q: Haryana state was formed on the recommendation of which committee?
HR GK.e: Haryana’s creation in 1966 followed the recommendations of Justice Prakash Singh Committee.

HR GK.q: Which among the following was an ancient name of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Ancient texts referred to the region as Brahmavarta/Brahmavrat.

HR GK.q: Haryana Legislative Assembly is ______ in nature.
HR GK.e: Haryana has a single-house legislature (Vidhan Sabha).

HR GK.q: The first Legislative Assembly elections were held in Haryana in the year:
HR GK.e: Following state formation (1966), the first Assembly elections were conducted the same year.

HR GK.q: The term of the State Legislative Assembly is:
HR GK.e: Unless dissolved earlier, the Assembly’s term is five years.

HR GK.q: Who was the first Speaker of Haryana Vidhan Sabha?
HR GK.e: Shanno Devi served as the first Speaker of the Haryana Legislative Assembly.

HR GK.q: Which is the largest Lok Sabha constituency in Haryana in terms of area?
HR GK.e: Geographically, Bhiwani–Mahendragarh is the largest LS constituency in the state.

HR GK.q: How many times has President’s Rule been imposed in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Haryana has come under President’s Rule three times since 1966.

HR GK.q: Who has been Chief Minister of Haryana for the maximum number of times?
HR GK.e: O. P. Chautala has served multiple terms as Chief Minister.

HR GK.q: Who was the first Chief Minister of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Pandit Bhagwat Dayal Sharma was the first CM (1966–67).

HR GK.q: By whom is the Council of Ministers of the state appointed?
HR GK.e: The Governor appoints ministers on the advice of the Chief Minister.

HR GK.q: Which of the following constituencies does NOT come under the district of Yamunanagar?
HR GK.e: Kalanaur is in Rohtak district; Jagadhri, Sadhaura and Radaur are in Yamunanagar.

HR GK.q: Nuh comes under the district of:
HR GK.e: Nuh is the headquarters of Mewat district (the district itself is now officially named Nuh).

HR GK.q: Sohna constituency comes under the district of:
HR GK.e: Sohna town/assembly constituency lies within Gurugram district.

HR GK.q: Where is the Haryana Public Service Commission located?
HR GK.e: The Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) headquarters is located in Panchkula.

HR GK.q: Match the following (A. Pehowa, B. Samalkha, C. Hansi, D. Bawal) with (1. Hisar, 2. Rewari, 3. Kurukshetra, 4. Panipat). Codes (A B C D):
HR GK.e: Pehowa–Kurukshetra, Samalkha–Panipat, Hansi–Hisar, Bawal–Rewari.

HR GK.q: After partition, the East Punjab High Court was established at:
HR GK.e: Post-partition, the East Punjab High Court first functioned from Shimla.

HR GK.q: In which year was the seat of the Punjab High Court shifted to Chandigarh?
HR GK.e: The High Court shifted from Shimla to Chandigarh in 1955.

HR GK.q: The principal seat of the Haryana High Court is in:
HR GK.e: Haryana shares the Punjab & Haryana High Court located in Chandigarh.

HR GK.q: How many environmental courts have been established by the Haryana Government?
HR GK.e: Special environmental courts function at Faridabad and Hisar.

HR GK.q: On which date did the Haryana Panchayati Raj Act come into force?
HR GK.e: The Act commenced on 22 April 1994 to strengthen rural self-governance.

HR GK.q: After the 73rd Constitutional Amendment, how many subjects’ functions were entrusted to PRIs?
HR GK.e: The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects for Panchayati Raj Institutions.

HR GK.q: From which date was the mandate to fix minimum qualifications for Panchayats adopted in Haryana?
HR GK.e: Educational qualifications for Panchayat candidates were enforced from this date.

HR GK.q: Which district has the highest number of Gram Sabhas?
HR GK.e: Gurugram district records the highest count of Gram Sabhas in the state.

HR GK.q: Block Development & Panchayat Officer (BDPO) is appointed at which tier?
HR GK.e: The BDPO administers Panchayati Raj activities at the block level.

HR GK.q: Haryana is divided into how many administrative divisions?
HR GK.e: The six divisions are Ambala, Rohtak, Hisar, Gurugram, Karnal, and Faridabad.

HR GK.q: Which district of Haryana is famous for scientific equipment?
HR GK.e: Ambala is nicknamed “Science City” for its scientific/surgical instrument industry.

HR GK.q: Which district is known as the ‘Holy City’ of Haryana?
HR GK.e: Kurukshetra is revered for the Mahabharata battlefield and the Bhagavad Gita.

HR GK.q: Panchkula is famous for:
HR GK.e: Panchkula hosts electronics and light engineering industries.

HR GK.q: Kalesar Wildlife Sanctuary is located in:
HR GK.e: Kalesar lies in the Shivalik foothills of Yamunanagar district.

HR GK.q: Which district is famous for henna (mehndi) production?
HR GK.e: Faridabad is noted for large-scale mehndi production.

HR GK.q: Panchvati is located at:
HR GK.e: Panchvati is a prominent religious site in Palwal district.

HR GK.q: Mahendragarh district ranks first in the production of:
HR GK.e: Mahendragarh leads in mustard cultivation within Haryana.

HR GK.q: Haryana’s first nuclear power plant was set up in which district?
